carbon_ceramic_matrix.description: Indestructible woven carbon/CNT skeleton vacuum-infused with fired local alumina-silicate clay. Features high planar heat spreading but requires vertical thermal pinning.

fused_quartz.description: Locally sourced quartz isolation shield providing complete magnetic and thermal transparency to protect the core processor brain from flux fields.

molten_salt_electrolyte.description: Abundant local table salt and aluminum chloride mixture. Entirely inert when solid; highly ionic and active when molten.

anodized_aluminum_pins.description: Lightweight, recycled household aluminum formed into tapered pins. Hard-anodized with an Al2O3 sapphire skin to isolate electrical currents while providing high-speed vertical thermal highways.

powdered_iron_flux_guides.description: Finely crushed scrap iron mixed into non-conductive binder. 3D-printable or moldable matrix used by the AI to warp permanent magnet paths and bypass traditional locking equilibrium sticky points.

fired_clay_insulators.description: Common regional kiln-fired structural clay used as a high-temperature structural barrier between the energetic magnetic gates and the primary carbon hull.
